course_title: Startup Battle School: Building AI-Powered Ventures

modules.title: Business 101 & Lean AGI
modules.summary: Startup lifecycle from conception to scale, Lean AGI landscape, cognitive science of human-AI copilot collaboration, and prompt engineering foundations.
modules.unischool_quest: Configure your team's AI Copilot stack & submit your 3-hypothesis Venture Thesis.
modules.deliverable_prompt: One-sentence startup thesis + AI copilot workflow

modules.title: The Problem & The Market
modules.summary: Identify hair-on-fire problems, segment beachhead markets, estimate bottom-up TAM, and synthesize structured user profiles.
modules.unischool_quest: Interactive Bottom-Up TAM Calculator & Customer Discovery Interview Targeter (min 15 interviews).
modules.deliverable_prompt: Beachhead persona + bottom-up TAM ($ users × ACV) + 15 named interview targets

modules.title: Product & Customer Feedback Synthesis
modules.summary: Design minimum lovable AI products around quantified customer pain, write crisp User Stories, and synthesize primary market research (PMR).
modules.unischool_quest: User Story Syntax Generator + AI Customer Interview Synthesis Matrix.
modules.deliverable_prompt: Top 3 validated user stories + live prototype / demo link

modules.title: Sales, Growth & Partnership Engine
modules.summary: 'Know you can make sales before you spend on marketing!' Lead generation, qualification, closing, CAC, Churn, LTV/CAC ratio, and Partner Need Matrix.
modules.unischool_quest: Beachhead Sales Funnel & LTV/CAC Unit-Economics Simulator + Cold Outreach Lab.
modules.deliverable_prompt: First 10 qualified prospect conversations + Partner Need Matrix

modules.title: AI-Powered Marketing & Sustainable Growth
modules.summary: Rapid digital experiment design, channel CAC calibration, and avoiding 'Jumping the Shark' premature scaling.
modules.unischool_quest: 'Jumping the Shark' Growth vs. Retention Simulator & Funnel Pro-Forma.
modules.deliverable_prompt: 2 low-cost channel experiments + measured conversion / CAC baseline

modules.title: Finance Essentials & SaaS Unit Economics
modules.summary: Assets = Liabilities + Equity, Gross Margin, ARR, EBIT/EBITDA, and translating Stripe/sales telemetry into clean pro-forma statements.
modules.unischool_quest: Interactive 24-Month SaaS Pro-Forma & Gross-Margin Sanity Checker.

modules.title: Venture Capital, SAFE Math & Deal Memos
modules.summary: How VCs underwrite power-law multiples, emotional + financial narrative calibration, post-money SAFE dilution math, and writing an institutional Deal Memo.
modules.unischool_quest: SAFE Cap-Table Dilution Simulator + Investor Deal Memo & Pitch Calibrator.
modules.deliverable_prompt: 1-Page Executive Summary (BASICS Booklet format) + Target VC Fit List

modules.title: Powerful Presentations, Mentor Madness & Demo Day
modules.summary: 1-on-1 mentor/investor gauntlet, leadership under uncertainty, finalized Executive Summary + VC Deck, and clearing the Ready-Gate (>= 80/100) for Berkeley Syndicate & YC.
modules.unischool_quest: Live 100-Point Ready-Gate Audit -> Request Mike, Uri & Mentor Sign-Off.
modules.deliverable_prompt: Final 3-min Pitch Video + Deck + Executive Summary submitted to Ready-Gate
